text: You just watched a key for seven seconds... [chuckles softly] a key that doesn't exist.
And you're still here... waiting for it to turn.
So if you can watch that for seven seconds... you can watch this for another fifteen.
This is you. At the foot of a door you've been scratching at your whole life.
Every salah. Every ayah... you've only scratched the surface. Never knowing how deep it goes.
You can open it, if you're ready. And it's as simple as learning the language it speaks: Arabic.
Start today at رَفِيق Arabic dot com... and tell me in the comments: what's the first thing you'd want to understand?
